form_classes.definition: Administered to settle the operator into the interface. Never scored, never linked.
Administered to expose the form. Never scored into an operational estimate.
Scored once per cycle and tracked in the exposure ledger.
Administered without the agent and without the transcript. Reported in the longitudinal lane only.

equivalence.statement: Different seeds do not make equivalent forms. No anchor opportunities, coverage evidence, difficulty evidence, or drift monitoring exist for these six, so two cycles under different seeds are two measurements and not two administrations of the same test.

exposure_ledger.statement: An operational form is scored once. A repeat of a form the operator has already seen is practice, and repeated improvement on it may be memorisation rather than learning; the sequence and the interval are recorded so that it can be told.

unadministered_opportunity_sources.statement: No form administers an independent initial judgment before the advice, so no reliance opportunity exists in this cycle. Advice-acceptance frequency alone cannot stand in for one.

The operator plan is validated and digested before the run, and its projection is recorded, but no scored opportunity is derived from it. Every operator process cell outside the checkpoint window is therefore unpopulated.
No held-out phase is administered in a v0.2.0 cycle.
